subject: Purchase reference issuance and spend ceiling alignment for AcmeTech onboarding
messages:
From: Lauren Price <lprice@acmetech.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-14T13:02:00-04:00
Subject: AcmeTech onboarding: PO request + spend ceiling details

Hi Grace / Ben,

Thanks again for the quick demo earlier this week. Procurement at AcmeTech would like to kick off vendor setup and issue a provisional purchase reference so we can get the first invoices flowing. Attached is our completed onboarding form and the initial PO breakdown that Finance prepared. A few details up front: 

- Requested spend ceiling: USD 120,000 for Q3 (2026) with an optional extension pending usage review.
- Invoice cadence: monthly. We prefer consolidated invoices when possible.
- Line item breakdown: Finance provided 6 line items; some of the item codes are internal to AcmeTech (e.g., SC-12) — I can map if you need Redwood SKUs.

Could you confirm the PO number we should reference, any required vendor tax info, and the preferred remit/bank details for Redwood? Also let us know if the spend ceiling will be enforced at invoicing or via a provisional block.

Attachments: Acme_onboard_form.xlsx, initial_po_breakdown.csv

Appreciate it — looking to get the first invoice submitted by 5/25.

Cheers,
Lauren Price
Head of Procurement
AcmeTech
procurement@acmetech.com
Phone: +1 415 555 0199

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Price <lprice@acmetech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-14T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AcmeTech onboarding: PO request + spend ceiling details

Hi Lauren — thanks for sending everything over and for the clear breakdown.

Quick answers:
- We can provision a PO reference for you today to allow invoices to route through Finance.
- Spend ceiling enforcement can be handled two ways: an internal spend gate that rejects charges beyond the cap, or a soft cap where we allow throughput and flag overruns for manual approval. If you need hard enforcement we can toggle that on; confirm which you prefer.
- For invoices we need the vendor tax ID and either a remittance email (AR contact) or bank details if you need wire instructions on file.

Ben handles PO assignments and the ledger-side mapping — Ben, can you confirm a provisional PO reference and whether we should enforce the cap automatically? Also flag any line-item mapping redlines (Acme's SC codes vs our service SKUs).

Happy to hop on a 15 min call tomorrow if that would speed the mapping.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

Subject: Re: AcmeTech onboarding: PO request + spend ceiling details

Hi all — looping in with the provisional assignment and a couple of notes.

1) Provisional PO: PO-ACM-2026-0893 (please reference this on all invoices submitted for the initial onboarding tranche). Official PO doc attached. 

Attachment: po_assignment_notice.pdf

2) Spend ceiling: We set the cap to USD 120,000 and enabled automatic enforcement at the billing stage (system will block tokenized charges that would push monthly billed spend beyond the remaining cap). If you prefer soft alerts instead, say the word and we can change it before go-live.

3) Line item mapping: I reviewed the CSV you sent. Two mismatches jumped out: Acme code SC-12 and SC-14 map to our service SKU namespace svc.12 and svc.14 but the descriptions differ slightly (Acme uses "Real-time Inference" vs our "Low-latency Text Generation (rt)"). To avoid reconciliation drift please confirm whether we should keep Redwood descriptions or prefer Acme's strings on the invoice lines. If you want us to ingest your codes directly we can create an alias table — that will preserve your SC codes on exported invoices.

4) Banking / AR: We need either the vendor tax ID (EIN) and an AR contact email to finalize vendor setup. If you'll be paying via purchase order to Redwood's standard remittance (ar@redwood.com) we can start invoicing once the signed onboarding form is back.

Next steps I propose: Lauren uploads the filled banking/AR info on page 2 of the onboarding form, confirms invoice description preference (Redwood or Acme labels) and we flip the switch for hard enforcement. If you want a quick mapping table we'll prepare a first-pass alias CSV for you to review by EOD.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Phone: +1 650 555 0321

Thanks Ben — that provisional PO number works for us.

I uploaded page 2 of the onboarding workbook with banking and AR contact (see attached v2) and signed the Docusign envelope — link below. For the invoice descriptions, we'd prefer our Acme labels to appear on the line items so our internal ledger matches without extra transformation; if you can ingest the alias table we'll accept that approach.

I've attached the updated master form and left a note in cell B14 about the SC-12/SC-14 descriptions — please use the alias table option and I'll have our finance team review your first-pass CSV. If everything looks good we'll schedule the first invoice for 5/25 as planned.

Attachments: acmetech_master_onboard_form_v2.xlsx
